patch_description:
The current program (score 0.64) over-parameterized with 38 parameters and alternating Ising gates, losing the efficiency of prior designs. The best prior (0.72 score) used only 14 parameters with a simple structure: shared RZ pre-sandwich → CZ chain → shared RZ post-sandwich + shared RY on all qubits.

This edit tests replacing the shared RY with a shared RX while preserving the minimal, proven architecture. RX rotates around the X-axis rather than Y, which may better suit the problem geometry while maintaining parameter economy. The change is minimal and isolated (only one gate type substitution), allowing direct comparison of axis choice.

This should recover the ~0.72 combined score by restoring parameter efficiency (from 0.03 to ~0.07) while potentially matching or exceeding prior accuracy.
